{{Quote|Never concede to evil. That is our oldest and most sacred law. When we concede to evil, even in a small way, we feed it, and it grows stronger.|Augwynne Djo|<ref name="CoPL" />}}
'''Augwynne Djo''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] of the [[Witches of Dathomir]], and eventually rose to be the nominal [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]; however, this was little more than a [[Monarchy/Legends|constitutional formality]]. Djo was the grandmother of [[Teneniel Djo]], great-grandmother of [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], and great-great grandmother of [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]].

Augywnne Djo had many adventures as clan mother. She once helped [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] on his journey to learn the secrets of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ramage]]. She also once drove away the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], another witch clan, with help from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and gained the deed to Dathomir in exchange for 3 favors requested by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|You are Augwynne Djo, are you not?|Jax Pavan|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
[[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] decades before the [[Declaration of a New Order|founding]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Augwynne Djo was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and a member of the [[Witches of Dathomir]], a society dominated by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] women.<ref name="CoPL" />

===Clan mother===
{{Quote|The Singing Mountain clan is in constant conflict with the Nightsisters, another clan of Force-users here on Dathomir.|Augwynne Djo|<ref name="SWG Date">{{GalaxiesAED}} and''[[The Nightsister's Revenge]]'' both take place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref>}}
At some point before the rise of the Empire<ref name="TLJ" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Episode III date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> she had become the [[Clan mother/Legends|clan mother]] of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]], a [[Coven/Legends|coven]] of witches that claimed the territory located in the vicinity of an [[Singing Mountain (Dathomir)/Legends|eponymous]] landform. Mother Augwynne and her [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|sisters]] were the guardians of a ruined [[Star Temple]],<ref name="TLJ" /> a type of mysterious pyramid built by the ancient,<ref name="Infinity's End" /> [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]]<ref name="TOFF 139">{{FactFile|139|DAT 1-4|Dathomir}}</ref> [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in order to protect a [[Infinity Gate|powerful artifact]]<ref name="Infinity's End">''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''</ref> capable of transport across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TOFF 139" />

====Familial troubles====
During her tenure as clan mother, the life of Augwynne Djo unfolded in tragedy. All four of her daughters ended up being lost to her, either through [[Death/Legends|death]] or betrayal. Djo's oldest daughter, [[Barukka]], had dabbled in the forbidden teachings of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and the clan mother had been forced to cast her out.<ref name="CTD" /> Another one of her daughters, [[Allaya Djo]], acted as the clan's warmaster and bore a daughter named [[Teneniel Djo|Teneniel]], but met an untimely death in battle.<ref name="CoPL" /> But worst of all was the loss of [[Gethzerion]], who had always been Mother Augwynne's favorite. Gethzerion and Barukka, both lost to the dark side, became [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. Gethzerion and her friend [[Baritha]] even attempted to murder their own mother, a plan that was only foiled by the sacrifice of their youngest sister [[Kara'Teel]], who gave her life to protect Augwynne.<ref name="CTD" /> However, following these tragedies, Augwynne decided to adopt [[Aelta]].<ref name="SWGQuest" />

====Star Temples====
In 19 BBY,<ref name="TLJ date">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']] dates itself to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 years before the]] events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of the film to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], thus the book must take place in 19 BBY.</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] visited Dathomir in order to search for a Star Temple. After landing on the Singing Mountain, Jax was escorted to Djo's quarters by sisters [[Magash Drashi]] and [[Duala Aidu]]. After conversing for a bit, Djo granted him permission to journey to the Star Temple. When Pavan returned from the temple, Djo and the other sisters agreed to help Pavan open the [[SD41263.I]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] in order to learn the secrets of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ramage]]. The holocron would only activate after being provided [[Blood/Legends|blood]] from a Force-sensitive being. Djo, Aida, Pavan, and Drashi each donated blood to open the holocron. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] returned from his [[Infiltration of Kantaros Station|infiltration]] of [[Kantaros Station]], Pavan had his mind cleared of his dark knowledge by Djo, per a request Pavan had made prior.<ref name="TLJ" />

====Era of Rebellion====
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="SWG Date" /> Augwynne informed Jedi Knight [[Rachi Sitra]] about a danger one of the Nightsisters, [[Kyrisa]], had represented to her clan.<ref name="LS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref> After the murder of her daughter Aelta at the hands of Gethzerion, Augwynne adopted [[Chastina]] and gave her a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] once belonging to Gethzerion.<ref name="SWGQuest" />

[[File:Augwynnedjo.jpg|left|thumb|Augwynne Djo during the era of the New Republic.]]

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TCoPL Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> Augwynne was present when [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] members [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] arrived at the Singing Mountain Clan. Djo declared Solo a free man from the [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] of the Nightsisters after Organa presented his case. Learning Solo owned the deed to Dathomir, she gave him the chance to make three requests in order to gain it. Solo asked Djo to get him off Dathomir, give him the [[Gold/Legends|gold]] and gems that were plentiful on the planet, and find a way to get Organa to marry him. However, she did not complete Solo's third request, as she believed she could not force Organa to marry him. Augwynne went to her chambers, conversing with the [[Council of Sisters]] ([[Tannath]], [[Azbeth]], [[Shen (Dathomiri)|Shen]]) about the danger of fighting the Nightsisters. Djo had no choice but to lead the sisters of the Singing Mountain Clan against the Nightsisters in order to give Solo time to get the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] off Dathomir. She requested help from the [[Red Hills Clan]] and [[Frenzied River Clan]] however neither clan offered forces or assistance.

Thanks to Jedi Knight [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Chume'da]] [[Isolder]] of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], Solo, Organa, Chewbacca, and her granddaughter, Teneniel, the sisters of the Singing Mountain Clan were able to drive the Nightsisters away. Augwynne and the sisters were finally rid of the Nightsisters when they were shot down trying to escape Dathomir by the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]] whose [[Zsinj's Empire|empire]] ruled the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]]. After the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]], Augwynne became the owner of Dathomir when Solo turned over the deed.

Around the same time, her surviving daughter, Barukka, returned from the dark and rejoined the clan, much to Augwynne's joy. Augwynne advocated for Dathomir's membership in the [[New Republic]].<ref name="CoPL" />

====Later life====
{{Quote|Does Augwynne Djo still rule here?"<br />"Yes. My great-grandmother.|Luke Skywalker and Tenel Ka|<ref name="Shadow Academy">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>}}
In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]],<ref name="SA Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]'' to [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].</ref> Skywalker and Augwynne's great-granddaughter, [[Tenel Ka Djo]], came to Dathomir for Augwynne's help in finding the resurgent Nightsisters and the [[Shadow Academy]]. Augwynne spoke with the Council of Sisters. When returning, she stated to Skywalker that visitors would be coming by and could answer their questions. After [[Great Canyon Clan]] visitors [[Vonnda Ra]] and [[Vilas]] came by and told the story of the Nightsisters, Skywalker and Tenel decided to go to the [[Great Canyon (Dathomir)/Legends|Great Canyon]]. Before their departure, Augwynne gave them cloaks and hugged Tenel, embracing her before sending them off.<ref name="Shadow Academy" />

That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Lightsabers Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'' to [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].</ref> Augwynne's favorite [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] died and Tenel Ka kept two of the animal's smaller teeth, which she used as the hilt for [[Tenel Ka Djo's lightsaber|her]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Lightsabers">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]''</ref>

In [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]],<ref name="CaCR Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Crisis at Crystal Reef]]'' to [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].</ref> she and the rest of the [[Djo family]] visited Tenel when she graduated from the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Crisis at Crystal Reef">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Crisis at Crystal Reef]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But, Mother, he is a stranger. And a man."<br />"He is a Jedi.|Magash Drashi and Augwynne Djo|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
Djo had pale [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Hair/Legends|hair]] the [[Color/Legends|color]] of moonlight. She was tall and regal, with facial features considered handsome by her fellow Humans, as well as graceful, long-fingered [[Limb/Legends|hands]].<ref name="TLJ" /> By 19 BBY,<ref name="TLJ date" /> she had the appearance of a sixty-year old woman though she was many centuries older.<ref name="TLJ" />

Unlike her fellow sisters,<ref name="CoPL" /> Djo was more welcome to outsiders.<ref name="TLJ" /> She was shrewd and calculating,<ref name="CTD" /> having been able to manipulate Han Solo into the bargain that gained her the deed to Dathomir.<ref name="CoPL" /> She tended to stick to her clan laws,<ref name="LS" /> but tended to break them at times.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|If I survive my &hellip; attempt to rescue my friend, I wish to return here and have you purge this knowledge from my mind. Utterly purge it, so that it will never be misused, either by Vader or by me."<br />"As you wish.|Jax Pavan and Augwynne Djo|<ref name="TLJ" />}}
Djo was skilled in [[Dathomir Magic|Allyan Magic]], exhibiting many [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]]. Using the Force, she could [[Tutaminis|absorb]] and dissipate energy, [[Force healing/Legends|heal]], [[Control Pain|control pain]], conjure [[Force barrier/Legends|shields]], [[Projective Telepathy|communicate with others at long distances]], [[Receptive Telepathy|read people's thoughts and feel their emotions]], use [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Kill|kill]] people telekinetically, [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Whirlwind|create storms telekinetically]], [[Comprehend Speech|comprehend speech]], [[Transfer Force|transfer force]],<ref name="CTD" /> and [[Drain Knowledge|drain people of knowledge]].<ref name="TLJ" /> She also knew how to swim, which she taught her great-granddaughter, Tenel Ka.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Equipment==
When in full regalia, Mother Djo wore a tunic of glittering yellow scales over a hide robe with black lizard shapes sewn around the hem. Her ceremonial headdress was made of smooth golden [[Wood/Legends|wood]], and was decorated with cabochons of yellow tigereye.<ref name="CoPL" /> On other occasions, Djo was known to wear a coronet of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Augwynne Djo first appeared in the [[1994]] novel, ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', written by [[Dave Wolverton]].<ref name="CoPL" />

Oddly, ''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]'' states that she was the one to have married Han and Leia Solo,<ref name="CTD" /> however this contradicts ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''.<ref name="CoPL" /> This article assumes the ''The Courtship of Princess Leia'' is correct. ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' incorrectly states that Augwynne took over as the clan's mother due to the death of her daughter Allaya.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, multiple sources establish that she was mother long before the death of Allaya.<ref name="CoPL" /><ref name="TLJ" /><ref name="LS" /><ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> This article assumes that those sources are correct.
